meta.name: All Nighter
meta.description: When a globe-trotting, workaholic father trying to visit his daughter on a last minute layover in Los Angeles discovers that she’s disappeared, he forces her awkward, nervous ex-boyfriend, still nursing a broken heart, to help him find her over the course of one increasingly crazy night.
meta.slogan: The fastest way to get over an ex? Stay up all night with her dad.
